title: Coherent ring diagrams from upper extensions of chains
statement: theorem exists_compatible_ring_tower (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (K : Type v) [CommRing K] (I : Type w) (q : I → K) (P : ∀ (A : Type w) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A], (A →+* K) → Prop) (hbase : ∃ (A : Type w) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : Algebra R A) (ψ : A →+* K), P A ψ) (hstep : ∀ (J : Type w) [LinearOrder J] [Nonempty J] (A : J → Type w) [∀ j, CommRing (A j)] [∀ j, Algebra R (A j)] (f : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → A i →ₐ[R] A j) [DirectedSystem A (fun i j h ↦ f i j h)] (ψ : ∀ j, A j →+* K), (∀ i j h a, ψ j (f i j h a) = ψ i a) → (∀ j, P (A j) (ψ j)) → ∀ x : K, ∃ (B : Type w) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra R B) (φ : B →+* K) (g : ∀ j, A j →ₐ[R] B), (∀ i j h a, g j (f i j h a) = g i a) ∧ (∀ j a, φ (g j a) = ψ j a) ∧ P B φ ∧ ∃ b, φ b = x) : ∃ (_ : LinearOrder I) (A : I → Type w) (_ : ∀ i, CommRing (A i)) (_ : ∀ i, Algebra R (A i)) (f : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → A i →ₐ[R] A j), DirectedSystem A (fun i j h ↦ f i j h) ∧ ∃ (ψ : ∀ i, A i →+* K), (∀ i j h a, ψ j (f i j h a) = ψ i a) ∧ (∀ i, P (A i) (ψ i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∃ a, ψ i a = q i)

proof.text: Package each stage as its Type w carrier, ring and R-algebra structures and map to K. Package a record as a stage and one tagged source stage and incoming algebra map for every index. RecordGood asserts P, that q i is in the image, that strict predecessor source tags agree, that incoming maps commute with K, and their composition law for two strict predecessors. Source transports cancel by equality induction.

proof.text: Given locally good predecessor records at i, recover the coherent diagram indexed by {j // j < i}: diagonal maps are identities, strict maps are transported incoming maps. The earlier RecordGood equations give the DirectedSystem and K-compatibility laws, including equality cases. If this index type is nonempty, apply hstep to that diagram and q i. If it is empty, apply hstep to the constant singleton diagram on ULift Unit with the base ring and identity maps. Store the resulting stage and cocone in extendRecord, filling unused incoming entries with identities. Reading back a stored map cancels the two opposite source transports, so the cocone equations prove RecordGood for the new record.

proof.text: Use the proved private coherentChoice lemma on the fixed record type. Its recursive functional chooses a record satisfying the local predicate whenever one exists and otherwise returns the base record. WellFoundedLT.fix defines the family, fix_eq supplies the recursion equation, and well-founded induction proves that the local extension argument applies at every index, so every chosen record is good and the default is never needed.

proof.text: Project carriers, ring and algebra structures, and maps to K from the good family. Define transition maps by identities on the diagonal and by incoming maps at strict pairs. Strict composition is RecordGood at the last stage; equality cases reduce to identities. The same split proves compatibility with K. P and image containment are the first two clauses of RecordGood. No nonemptiness of I is required, and the construction retains all carriers in Type w.

mathlib_searches.query: A well ordered compatible diagram can be built by recursively extending each previous initial segment by a coherent cocone
transfinite construction of compatible directed diagrams from coherent upper bounds of nonempty chains
mathlib_searches.results: InverseSystem.limit defines compatible families; Functor.WellOrderInductionData.Extension.instNonempty and ofExists require an already given inverse functor and successor/limit lifting data. These are machinery, not a one-line specialization to variable carrier rings and incoming maps.
